calls.expression:
typer.Typer(
    name="vvaharness",
    help="Agentic SAST pipeline: scan a repository for vulnerabilities.",
    add_completion=True,
    rich_markup_mode="rich",
    context_settings={"help_option_names": ["-h", "--help"]},
)

app.command("setup", context_settings=_PASSTHROUGH,
             help="Guided readiness check: AI agents, keys, deps, gateway, config.")

app.command("doctor", context_settings=_PASSTHROUGH,
             help="Check credentials and live backend connectivity (read-only). "
                  "[dim]--cache-probe adds a live prompt-cache diagnostic that spends real "
                  "tokens; it never runs during a scan.[/dim]")

app.command("estimate", context_settings=_PASSTHROUGH,
             help="Print a rough scope/cost preview for a repo (no API spend).")

app.command("gc", context_settings=_PASSTHROUGH,
             help="Delete old runs: checkpoints and code-graph workspaces (--keep-runs / --max-age-days / --dry-run).")

app.command("scan", context_settings=_PASSTHROUGH,
             help="Scan a repo (or --repo-file batch) for vulnerabilities. "
                  "[dim]The packaged default skips S10/S11; --remediate enables S10 only and can "
                  "edit source. In-scan S11 needs step_validate.enabled: true, and --stop-after s9 "
                  "skips both.[/dim]")

app.command("remediate", context_settings=_PASSTHROUGH,
             help="Walk findings from a prior scan and remediate them (Remediation Agent).")

app.command("validate", context_settings=_PASSTHROUGH,
             help="Run the s11 agentic validation agent on applied remediations.")

app.command("ev-replay", context_settings=_PASSTHROUGH,
             help="Re-check exploit-verified findings against a REDEPLOYED target.")
